summary: AppForge-LLM v4 is a Python/FastAPI AppForge package with a nested Vite/Vue frontend and a new Bun/TypeScript llm_bridge package. The requested feature touches the web UI, FastAPI proxy, job readiness/driver selection, bridge client/server, tests, and built static web assets.
stack: Python 3.14 virtualenv via uv for local verification
AppForge pipeline and artifact framework under appforge/
entry_points: appforge.web:create_app and appforge.web:serve for the local web server
appforge.web_jobs:JobManager for job creation, driver readiness, packaging, and status payloads
appforge.drivers:create_driver for selecting codex, claude, generic, or llm-bridge drivers
frontend/src/App.vue, TopBar.vue, and ProviderSettings.vue for the browser user flow
frontend/src/api.ts for same-origin web API calls
llm_bridge/src/server.ts and llm_bridge/src/index.ts for local provider API and generation endpoints
tests/test_web.py for web API and job-flow integration coverage
architecture: The browser SPA talks only to the FastAPI origin; FastAPI proxies /api/llm requests to the local bridge via appforge/llm_bridge.py.
The bridge owns provider registry, local provider config, active provider selection, connection tests, generation, and streaming.
JobManager.health reports driver readiness and blocks llm-bridge readiness unless the bridge is reachable and the selected provider is configured.
LLMBridgeDriver is a single-shot stage driver that calls bridge /generate and writes the final model output to the AppForge stage log.
Static frontend build artifacts are packaged under appforge/resources/web for the Python web app.
conventions: Backend routes use Pydantic request models and return structured JSON errors through WebJobError or bridge error handlers.
Frontend code uses Vue <script setup lang="ts">, central API helpers, and shared TypeScript payload types.
Tests prefer FastAPI TestClient with monkeypatched local boundaries instead of live network/provider calls.
Generated/runtime AppForge files, logs, reports, memory, .env files, node_modules, and .venv should stay ignored.
test_strategy: Run the full Python suite with .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q.
Run frontend typecheck and build with npm run typecheck and npm run build.
Run bridge TypeScript validation with bun run typecheck.
Avoid live provider tests in CI; use monkeypatched bridge functions for FastAPI proxy and readiness behavior.
Manual live-provider verification requires user-supplied credentials and a running llm_bridge service.
risk_areas: Secret handling: API keys must never be committed or echoed back to the browser after storage.
Readiness truthfulness: bridge reachability alone is insufficient; configured provider status must be checked.
Same-origin security: browser API should remain on /api/llm and not require direct browser-to-bridge calls.
NPM lock reproducibility: package-lock previously contained internal registry resolved URLs and mismatched public integrities.
Generated static assets: frontend build replaces hashed files under appforge/resources/web/assets.
